description: This file defines a PaymentReconciliation class for handling payment reconciliation processes in an ERP system, including fetching, allocating, and reconciling payment and invoice entries.

classes.name: PaymentReconciliation
classes.description: A class for managing payment reconciliation, including fetching, allocating, and reconciling payment and invoice entries.

methods.name: get_unreconciled_entries
methods.description: Fetches unreconciled payment and invoice entries.

methods.name: get_nonreconciled_payment_entries
methods.description: Retrieves non-reconciled payment entries, including payments, journal entries, and notes.

methods.name: get_payment_entries
methods.description: Fetches payment entries based on party type and other conditions.

methods.name: get_jv_entries
methods.description: Retrieves journal voucher entries related to the party.

methods.name: get_dr_or_cr_notes
methods.description: Fetches debit or credit notes related to the party.

methods.name: add_payment_entries
methods.description: Adds payment entries to the reconciliation object.

methods.name: get_invoice_entries
methods.description: Fetches invoice entries to be reconciled.

methods.name: add_invoice_entries
methods.description: Adds invoice entries to the reconciliation object.

methods.name: get_allocated_entry
methods.description: Creates an allocation entry for a payment and invoice.

methods.name: reconcile
methods.description: Performs the reconciliation process, creating journal entries as needed.

methods.name: get_payment_details
methods.description: Constructs payment detail dictionary for reconciliation.

methods.name: check_mandatory_to_fetch
methods.description: Validates required fields are set before processing.

methods.name: validate_entries
methods.description: Validates that invoice and payment tables are populated.

methods.name: validate_allocation
methods.description: Validates the allocation entries for correctness.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on date and amount filters for fetching invoices/payments.
